[NextItNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.05163) uses causal dilated convolutions and residual blocks. [SkipRec](https://cdn.aaai.org/ojs/16518/16518-13-20012-1-2-20210518.pdf) learns user-specific binary block-execution policies through Gumbel-Softmax or reinforcement learning, enabling inference savings. Crucially, its NextItNet+ backbone already includes zero-initialized learnable residual coefficients. Softmax aggregation of computed depths changes representation selection without inherently reducing computation. [Jumping Knowledge](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v80/xu18c/xu18c.pdf) already aggregates intermediate depths through concatenation, coordinatewise max pooling, or node-adaptive LSTM attention; adaptive receptive-field selection is therefore established prior art.

[ELMo](https://aclanthology.org/N18-1202.pdf) learns task-specific softmax scalar layer weights and an overall scale, optionally normalizing layers before mixing. Its mixing weights are shared across tokens; a content-conditioned positionwise gate differs through input-dependent weights. [ReZero](https://arxiv.org/html/2003.04887v2) initializes each residual-branch scalar to zero. For the proposed readout, y_t=h_L,t+αΣ_l a_t,l(h_l,t−h_L,t), normalized weights imply y_t=(1−α)h_L,t+αΣ_l a_t,l h_l,t. Thus α=0 preserves the original final-state readout, not an identity-initialized backbone. This algebraic interpretation suggests a specific combination of established mechanisms, rather than establishing broad novelty. Channel-only normalization and prefix-dependent gates preserve temporal causality; full-sequence gate pooling can violate it.

Paper-supported comparisons include ELMo’s last-only versus approximately uniform versus learned mixing; JK’s aggregation alternatives; SkipRec’s learned versus random policies, pretraining, and policy architectures; and ReZero’s residual/normalization baselines. Proposed additional controls: final-only; global versus positionwise weights; normalization on/off; direct mixing versus final-state correction; α initialized at zero versus nonzero, with fixed versus learned α. Keep backbone, training budget, and evaluation matched; report recommendation accuracy and runtime separately. These proposed controls are deductions, not experiments reported for this exact combination.
